Ghar Jalaya Gaya Hai Jafar Ka
Jaisay Zahra Ka Dar Jalaya Tha

1
Yaad Aane Lagi Shab-e-Ashor
Phir Madina Bana Hai Karb-o-Bala

2
Ghar Mein Syedaniyaan Bhi Thin Mojood
Phir Woh Manzar Tha Sham-e-Ghurbat Ka

3
Kyun Gareebon Ka Ghar Jalatay Ho
Kya Musalmaan Nahi Hai Khoof-e-Khuda

4
Dushmani Kya Hai Aal-e-Ahmad Se
Phir Muhammad Ko Kyun Rulaya Gaya

5
Youn Giraftar Kaun Karta Hai
Kyun Musalay Se Hai Ghaseeta Gaya

6
Haye Maula Imam-e-Sadiq Ko
Zehar De Kar Shaheed Kar Dala

7
Yeh Yateemi Ki Shab Hai Kazim Ki
Phir Se Zahra Hain Aaj Mehway Boka

8
Qabar Mismar Misal-e-Zahra Hai
Our Roney Pe Bhi Hai Pehra Laga

9
Kaisay Akhtar Biyaan Ho Woh Manzar
Ibn-e-Baqir Ka Jab Janaza Utha

from pathlib import Path
import sys

path = Path(sys.argv[1])
_, metadata, roman = path.read_text().split('---', 2)
metadata = metadata.strip('\\n').replace(

    'title: \"گھر جلایا گیا ہے جعفر کا\"\\nalternateTitle: \"Ghar Jalaya Gaya Hai Jafar Ka\"',
).replace('direction: \"ltr\"', 'direction: \"rtl\"').replace('tags: [\"noUrdu\"]', 'tags: []')
proper = dict(zip(
    \"Jafar Zahra Madina Ahmad Muhammad Maula Sadiq Kazim Akhtar\".split(),
    \"Jafar Zahra Madina Ahmad Muhammad Maula Sadiq Kazim Akhtar\".split(),
))
proper.update({\"shab-e-ashor\": \"Shab-e-Ashor\", \"karb-o-bala\": \"Karb-o-Bala\",
               \"sham-e-ghurbat\": \"Sham-e-Ghurbat\", \"aal-e-ahmad\": \"Aal-e-Ahmad\",
               \"khuda\": \"Khuda\", \"imam-e-sadiq\": \"Imam-e-Sadiq\",
               \"misal-e-zahra\": \"misal-e-Zahra\", \"ibn-e-baqir\": \"Ibn-e-Baqir\"})
roman_lines = []
for line in roman.strip().splitlines():
    words = [proper.get(word, proper.get(word.lower(), word.lower())) for word in line.split()]
    if words:
        words[0] = words[0][0].upper() + words[0][1:]
    roman_lines.append('  ' + ' '.join(words) if words else '')

پھر وہ منظر تھا شامِ غربت کا

۳

کیا مسلمان نہیں ہے خوفِ خدا

۵
یوں گرفتار کون کرتا ہے
کیوں مصلّے سے ہے گھسیٹا گیا

۶
ہائے مولا امامِ صادق کو
زہر دے کر شہید کر ڈالا

۷
یہ یتیمی کی شب ہے کاظم کی

۸

۹

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu script for all 20 verses, preserving the two-line opening and nine numbered stanzas. Moved the Roman wording into `romanLyrics` with sentence casing, set the direction to RTL, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read “Our” as اور and “Mehway Boka” as محوِ بکا in the Urdu text. Both Roman spellings are preserved.
